en: This is a vintage postcard showing a sepia-toned view of a small town with various buildings and some railway infrastructure, set against a backdrop of hills and forests. The top left corner of the image side bears the printed text 'Ånge, Stationssamhället.' The reverse side has handwritten correspondence, a 5 öre green Swedish stamp featuring a portrait, a postmark dated 1914, red printed lines for the address, and several Swedish publisher marks.
